steps.note: Water is warmed first in the pasteurising vat.
The powder is mixed into the warm water.
Whole buffalo milk is added, which brings the fat to about 3 % and the solids other than fat back to at least 8.5 %.
The milk undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.

processing.text: Single toned milk is not always pasteurised; double-toned milk always is.
